## Highlights

- General equity beliefs are associated with more reform-oriented teaching practice.
- The three object-specific belief dimensions show no credible association.
- School socioeconomic position is the stronger correlate of reported practice.
- The school-level association reverses by grade: positive Year 7, negative Year 8.
- Measurement and imputation uncertainty are carried into the multilevel model.
